meta.title: 拉花拉不出来，都是因为这几个小细节
meta.title_en: Can't Pour Latte Art? It's These Small Details
meta.topic: 咖啡拉花 · 细节要点

scenes.context: 选材三要素：好豆、好奶、好杯。拉花拉不出来，先检查选材——豆、奶、杯三个要素。语域：咖啡教学，选材讲解。
sentences: 选材三要素：好豆、好奶、好杯。
Three essentials: good beans, good milk, good cup.
Check the materials before the hands.
paraphrase: 选材 → choosing materials / the ingredients
scenes.speak: Three essentials: good beans, good milk, good cup. Poor picks make poor art. Check the materials before the hands.

scenes.context: 摇匀浓缩，让表面张力均匀。浓缩的表面张力均匀，拉花融合才顺滑。语域：咖啡教学，细节讲解。
sentences: Swirl the espresso to even out the tension.
even out the tension（张力均匀）
这是很多人忽略的细节。
paraphrase: 摇匀浓缩 → swirl the espresso / mix the shot
swirl the espresso · mix the shot
表面张力 → surface tension / the film
scenes.speak: Swirl the espresso to even out the tension. Even tension, smooth blending. A detail most people overlook.

scenes.context: 蒸汽棒伸入一半深度进气5-6秒。打奶泡时蒸汽棒深度和进气时长很关键。语域：咖啡教学，打奶讲解。
sentences: Dip the steam wand to half depth.
Aerate for five to six seconds.
Frothing milk comes down to this.
comes down to this（就靠这一步）
paraphrase: 蒸汽棒 → the steam wand / the steaming arm
scenes.speak: Dip the steam wand to half depth. Aerate for five to six seconds. Frothing milk comes down to this.

scenes.context: 倒缸让奶泡上下厚薄均匀；高融合到低拉花，心形完成。最后倒缸均匀奶泡，从高融合到低拉花收尾。语域：咖啡教学，收尾。
sentences: Transfer pitchers to even out the foam.
even out the foam（厚薄均匀）
blend high pour low（高融合低拉花）
the heart is complete（心形完成）
paraphrase: 倒缸 → transfer pitchers / pour between pitchers
高融合低拉花 → blend high, pour low / integrate then draw
blend high pour low · integrate then draw
scenes.speak: Transfer pitchers to even out the foam. Blend high, pour low. And the heart is complete.

practice: Three essentials: good beans, good milk, good cup.
Swirl the espresso to even out the tension.
Dip the steam wand to half depth and aerate for five to six seconds.
pitfalls: Three essentials: good beans, good milk, good cup.
Swirl the espresso to even out the tension.
Put the steam in the milk.
Dip the steam wand to half depth.
「蒸汽棒伸入」用 dip the steam wand to half depth。
「高融合低拉花」用 blend high, pour low。
shifts: 说拉花拉不出只会 fail
用 three essentials（三要素）、poor picks（选材不对）、check the materials（查选材）
用 even out the tension（均匀张力）、smooth blending（顺滑融合）、aerate（进气）
用 transfer pitchers（倒缸）、blend high pour low（高融合低拉花）、the heart is complete（心形完成）
footer_notes: 本视频无口播转录，场景数据基于图文实录图片说明（figcaption）重建。已校正：好豆好奶好杯、摇匀浓缩、表面张力、蒸汽棒半深进气5-6秒、倒缸、高融合低拉花、心形完成等。
